elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance with a limit of at least USD 1 million per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause requires comprehensive general liability coverage of at least USD 1 million but does not state that this is a per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2 million.
Professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 2 million.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only USD 1 million in professional errors and omissions coverage.

elements.element: For vendors processing Customer Data, cyber/privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least USD 5 million.
elements.evidence: The clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance, but only at USD 2 million. The Customer Data processing condition is not demonstrably absent.

elements.element: Workers' compensation insurance in the amount required by law.
elements.evidence: Contractor must maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: Contractor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: At Company's request, Contractor may provide certificates or instead provide other acceptable evidence of insurance or self-insurance, so certificates themselves are not unconditionally required.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 1 million.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 1 million throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: Cyber/privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least USD 2 million.
elements.evidence: The clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least USD 2 million throughout the Agreement term.

result.reason: The redline reaches the complete fallback by adding only the required USD 2 million cyber/privacy coverage; the existing USD 1 million E&O coverage already met the other fallback element. It does not reach the preferred position because the CGL limit is not stated on a per-occurrence basis, no USD 2 million aggregate is provided, E&O remains at USD 1 million, cyber/privacy remains at USD 2 million, and certificates may be replaced with other evidence. The change does not disturb unrelated commercial terms or introduce a contradiction.
